topSignals.title: Priority stack check — Elcogen and Topsoe both confirmed quiet, now well into their second week of silence.
topSignals.text: Direct checks of both companies' news pages show nothing posted since Elcogen's Sept 21 Metrosert testing-cooperation item (and the already-logged Sept 23 SOEC whitepaper), and Topsoe's press-release feed still shows the H1 2026 results as its most recent dated item — no SOEC/SOFC-specific announcement in the window. Elcogen News, Topsoe News

topSignals.title: PJM's 6 GW data-center backstop procurement remains in limbo, with no refiling or new timeline yet.
topSignals.text: Three days after FERC suspended the mechanism (new effective date Feb 28, 2027) and PJM pulled its Sept 30 auction launch, PJM has filed nothing further; a spokesperson says only that it is "reviewing the order and intend[s] to work quickly," with a new timeline still "yet to be determined." This keeps the nearest-term test case for PJM's valuation of behind-the-meter/on-site generation (including SOFC) open-ended. Utility Dive

topSignals.title: Broad quiet day; the next catalysts are now inside a week.
topSignals.text: Extended English/German searches across deployments, competing on-site power, market/financials, research and LCOE datapoints turned up nothing dated to the last 24-48h beyond items already on file. Germany's EEG-Novelle committee hearing is now just 3 days out (Oct 5), with the Netzpaket hearing 5 days out (Oct 7) and a final vote targeted around Oct 16; the KWK-Gesetz (CHP law) goes to cabinet Oct 14; Bloom Energy reports Q3 earnings Oct 27.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet — newsroom re-checked directly; most recent post remains the Sept 21 Metrosert multi-year testing-cooperation announcement (plus the already-logged Sept 23 SOEC whitepaper). No new stack/cell, capacity, or partnership news. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform in volume production at ELCO I Tallinn. Elcogen News
Topsoe (priority): Quiet — press-release page re-checked directly; most recent dated item is still the H1 2026 half-year statement. No SOEC/SOFC-specific item in the window. Topsoe News

Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin: no new stack/cell-technology announcements found in the window beyond already-logged items (financial/market news for Bloom, FuelCell Energy and Ceres covered below).

Live — see Top Signal #2:* PJM's 6 GW backstop procurement remains suspended with no refiling or new auction date three days after FERC's Sept 29 order; new effective date (if resubmitted successfully) is Feb 28, 2027.

No change, approaching:* Germany's EEG-Novelle/Netzpaket Redispatch-Vorbehalt track — committee hearings now 3 days (Oct 5, EEG) and 5 days (Oct 7, Netzpaket) out, final vote still targeted around Oct 16; both coalition negotiators continue signaling the clause is likely to be dropped.
No change:* Germany's KWK-Gesetz (CHP law) cabinet consideration remains scheduled for Oct 14.

No change* in the last 24-48h on: DOE/FERC large-load interconnection rulemaking (Apr 30, 2026 deadline); ITC 48E (30% fuel-cell credit) and 45V hydrogen credit; Virginia data-center electricity tax, New York permit moratorium, Texas development pause, EPA turbine NSPS; California's seven data-center bills signed Sept 21 — all as previously logged.
Bloom Energy (BE): No new operational or financial disclosures in the window. Q3 earnings now 25 days out, due Oct 27.

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): No new operational disclosures in the window; Nov 10, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline (Fit Energy cost-overrun disclosure suit) still pending; backlog remains $3.6B per the Q3 transcript.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new market-moving news since the Sept 17 UK grid-connection-delay whitepaper.

lcoe.text: No new cost, efficiency, capex/opex, or gas/H2/electricity price datapoint published in the last 24-48h beyond already-logged items (Pan et al. $3.49/kg LCOH; Kourougianni et al. >30% annualized-cost reduction for rSOC+PV; Kim 2026 50–60% net electrical efficiency for commercial SOFC systems; Sept 25 EIA Henry Hub summer-2026 average of $2.93/MMBtu).

Pending calendar (updated): PJM backstop procurement — new effective date Feb 28, 2027, resubmission timeline still TBD; German EEG/Netzpaket committee hearings Oct 5 (EEG, in 3 days) / Oct 7 (Netzpaket, in 5 days), final vote targeted Oct 16; German KWK-Gesetz cabinet consideration Oct 14; Bloom Q3 earnings Oct 27; FCEL lead-plaintiff deadline Nov 10; New Mexico air-quality permit deadline for Project Jupiter Nov 23.
